vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2111 (docs/skills/templates xbrief alignment); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Align docs, skills, and templates to xbrief naming and commands

narratives.Description: Update the agent-facing surface (skills, templates, AGENTS entry, and docs) to the xBRIEF prose term and lowercase xbrief paths, verbs, and the migrate:xbrief command. This spans many content files that must stay internally consistent, so it is marked sequential and run solo after the rename lands.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Rewrite content skills, content/templates/agents-entry.md, and docs to use xBRIEF in prose and xbrief/ paths, *.xbrief.json files, and xbrief:* verbs, then run task agents:refresh to regenerate the consumer AGENTS.md managed section. 2. Update the content contract test markers so the agents-entry contract validates the new tokens; run the content contract test suite to confirm propagation.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive user, I want docs and skills to describe xbrief consistently, so that guidance matches the renamed layout, verbs, and migrate:xbrief command.

items.title: Given the skills and docs, when scanned, then they use xBRIEF prose and xbrief paths

narrative.Acceptance: Given the content skills and docs, when scanned, then they reference xBRIEF in prose and xbrief/ paths and verbs consistently.

items.title: Given the template change, when agents:refresh runs, then the consumer AGENTS section updates

narrative.Acceptance: Given the updated agents-entry template, when task agents:refresh runs, then the consumer AGENTS.md managed section regenerates with xbrief tokens.

items.title: Given the new markers, when the contract test runs, then propagation validates green

narrative.Acceptance: Given the updated marker list, when the agents-entry contract test runs, then it validates the xbrief tokens and passes.
